51495169.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human USP7 (208 to 560 residues) by SPR method

original_paragraph.SPR Experiment: The SPR kinetic analysis was performed on a Biacore T200 (GE Healthcare). The human USP7CD (residues 208–560) was diluted in sodium acetate solution (pH 4.5) with a final concentration of 50 μg/mL and immobilized on a Biacore Sensor Chip CMS by amine-coupling with EDC/ethanolamine (response final achieved to approximately 15,000 RU). All compounds were tested in a running buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.05% Surfactant P20, 2 mM DTT, and 5% DMSO) with a flow rate of 30 μL/min, an association and dissociation time of 90 s, and under a solvent correction curve from 4.5 to 5.8%. The data were analyzed using Biacore T200 Evaluation Software and presented as the mean ± SEM (n ≥ 3).

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.05% Surfactant P20, 2 mM DTT, and 5% DMSO
